felt I had to leave a review because I believe some of the other reviews are unfair. I don’t expect anyone to read this review because it’s mahoosive but I needed to get my point across. I’ve been with this practice since being a child when they were in Bedford Road. I moved once which resulted in me having to go to Walton Village for a short time which was honestly the worst experience I’ve ever had. Since covid I agree a lot changed and things became difficult but things are difficult everywhere not just here. All of the doctors, nurses and staff at Walton Medical Centre have been so polite and helpful to me and to other patients when I’ve been present. To clarify, this building also houses Grey Road Surgery and I can’t comment on those doctors or staff because I've never dealt with them. I’ve had a very difficult and frightening year being extremely ill and the level of care from Walton Medical Centre doctors and staff has been amazing. When I became ill I had no idea what to do or where to go for help and only for the fact I mentioned something in passing to one of the staff on reception they made a note to mention me in their morning meeting and I received a call the next day and was referred to their Social Prescriber who has been the most amazing help to me and I can’t thank these people enough. The issue with the phone in the morning is if you want an appointment you just have to keep pressing redial until you get through. It depends how many patients are calling and how lucky you are pushing into the queue, so you could be trying for anywhere from 1-20 minutes to get through. For instance last week I only called 6 times which took 1 minute before I got through. This week took 125 times of pressing redial which took 8 minutes to get through. You can still be old school and go in person and wait until reception opens at 8am. Don’t forget, back in the day when you could book an appointment in advance a lot of those people didn’t bother to rock up or call to cancel so the likes of us who really needed an appointment didn’t stand a chance of getting one for weeks. You’d find yourself really ill but having to wait 2-3 weeks for an appointment which caused people to moan about that method too. You can thank those selfish patients for why we have this method now. Whatever this practice does won’t please everyone but this is probably the fairest way for us to book. They are always trying to come up with ways to make it easier for us like emailing to request repeat prescriptions or fit notes, this then leaves the lines free for anyone who maybe isn’t computer literate to call and get their request sorted. They also have an AI assistant now called PATCHS so if you’re unable to call for an appointment and for example you’ve hurt yourself, you can log everything on this and upload a picture of your injury and the doctor will get back to you. If you’ve made it to the end of this review, well done, I hope you didn’t have to take a day off work to read it.
